chapters.label: 01 · Riyadh Front · Quality of Life
chapters.line: A stand drawn as a courtyard.
chapters.sub: Open corners so people walk in, not past. Thirty thousand of them did.

chapters.label: 02 · Ramadan nights
chapters.sub: Arches, lanterns at eye level, a crescent you walk under. The city sleeps late in Ramadan, so the render did too.

chapters.label: 03 · Founding Day
chapters.line: Built to look old on day one.
chapters.sub: Mud walls, lanterns, the smell of coffee. All of it drawn before any of it existed.

chapters.label: 04 · World Defense Show
chapters.sub: Glass and brass, cut so the light does the engraving.

chapters.label: 05 · National Day 95
chapters.sub: A village for one night. Gate, carts, stage, horses. The only moment you cannot render.
Twenty years. Beirut to Riyadh. A hundred rooms that lasted one night and a few people who still talk about them. Tell him the date and the venue. He will draw the next one.
